description_en: Queries information about clients that have established SSL-VPN connections to Alibaba Cloud under a specified VPN gateway instance by calling the DescribeSslVpnClients operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeSslVpnClients接口查询指定VPN网关实例下已与阿里云建立SSL-VPN连接的客户端的信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-ssl-vpn-clients --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-gw8gfb947ctddabja0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSslVpnClients

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPN gateway instance.
